data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Helene', meaning 'shining light' or 'bright one'. In Greek mythology, Helene was a queen of Sparta and the wife of King Menelaus. The name Elane is a modern variant and carries the same symbolism of light and brightness. The name Elane carries the meaning “Light, Shining One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Elane usually hope their child will grow to embody light, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is a reminder that as followers of Christ, we are called to be the light of the world, illuminating the darkness around us through our actions and moral conduct. Additionally, it resonates with the biblical theme of Christ being the light and guide for those who believe in Him, offering comfort and light in the face of uncertainty and adversity. Thus, the name Elane encapsulates the transformative power of spirituality and faith, inspiring those who bear it to live a compassionate and virtuous life.
